threshold_source: expected move on fit rows only

bootstrap.undefined_ratios: omitted from intervals; valid resample counts stored

random.draw: without replacement, exact matched fire count

volatility_ties: stable input row order; exact matched fire count

decision.rule: Adopt v3 as an extra non-credit trigger only if, on BOTH F years, precision at P99 beats volatility only and the 95% interval of the difference excludes 0.
decision.line: Do not adopt v3 as an extra non-credit trigger; keep the credit and market-wide gates.
